use: Foresight displacement forecasts in use since early 2020; inform response planning and the annual Global Displacement Report
target_model: Forced-displacement population, long-term; explainable model with scenario analysis (class not stated in the abstract)
model_quality: Explainability built in as a design requirement

use: Model trigger and community action plans for anticipatory action ahead of conflict displacement in Akobo, South Sudan; activation not documented
target_model: Displaced population: Admin 1/2, 3--4 months ahead (Bayesian state-space, AHEAD); national, 1--3 years ahead (gradient-boosted trees and linear models, Foresight)
data: Sparse, sporadic subnational displacement data; uncertainty in official figures not modelled; too few protection-monitoring interviews; displacement and community data do not overlap, so the joint trigger is untested
governance: Turning forecasts into action is not straightforward; acting ahead of conflict can compromise perceived neutrality; a published forecast could prompt pre-emptive violence
model_quality: Surges and onsets missed; systematic underestimation by Foresight; trigger threshold depends on response capacity; ground truthing needed
organisational: Ethical and practical concerns with model-only decisions; reputational risk of sharing forecasts with communities; cost of acting on false alarms
infrastructure: No computing or connectivity barrier reported; a general need for systems to integrate more data
outcomes: No activation, reach or avoided-loss figures reported

organisation: Philippine Red Cross (with 510, Netherlands Red Cross, and German Red Cross)
use: Statistical impact-based model is the trigger of the Typhoon Early Action Protocol (approved 2019); it triggered early action before landfall of Typhoon Kammuri (2019)
target_model: Share of houses completely damaged per municipality, about 72 h before landfall; XGBoost, compared with an elementary wind-damage-curve model
data: Impact records aggregated or missing; no systematic storm-impact record in Bangladesh; damage records retrieved manually; outdated census inputs
governance: Transparency needed for trust; threshold setting trades rapid activation against resource efficiency; move to hybrid triggers that add local judgement
model_quality: Machine-learning model opaque to non-technical users; on Kammuri the deployed model detected few damaged municipalities (POD 0.03, FAR 0.75) with storm-track forecast uncertainty propagating into it; single-event evaluation
organisational: Limited technical capacity to manage complex models in some regions; risk of acting in vain
outcomes: Delivery of early actions and people reached not reported
